sections.title: Two tools, two jobs.
points: Plaud is designed around recording and transcription — capturing meetings and calls as text.
Tikpal is designed around ideas — capturing thoughts the moment they happen.
After recording, Tikpal keeps working: notes, tasks, calendar events and drafts.

sections.title: What Tikpal brings.
points: One press starts recording — no unlock, no app.
200 AI minutes every month, no subscription required.
16GB local storage — your recordings stay on the device first.
Connects with Todoist, Notion, Gmail and Calendar in the Tikpal App.

sections.title: Your words stay yours.
points: A clear light shows when Tikpal is listening.
Recordings are stored locally before anything syncs.
Your recordings are never used to train public models.

items.a: They're different tools for different jobs. Plaud focuses on recording and transcription, which serves meeting-heavy workflows well. Tikpal focuses on capturing everyday thoughts and turning them into memory and action. Choose based on how you work.
No. Tikpal includes 200 AI minutes every month, and core recording stays available without a subscription.

items.q: What happens after I use my 200 AI minutes?
items.a: Your 200 AI minutes refresh every month — unused minutes don't roll over. If you run out, AI features pause until the next month, but you can keep recording and everything stays saved on the device.
Most orders arrive within 5–10 business days in the US and Asia-Pacific, and 7–12 business days in Europe. Exact estimates are shown at checkout.

finalCta.title: The thought happens once. Don't lose it to the unlock screen.
